name: Brighter Shores
tested: Played on an iPhone (iPhone19,4, iOS 27.2) with Local signing on 13 November 2026 and Developer service on 12 November 2026: signs in to Steam and to the game's servers.
notes: The app signs in to Steam itself before the game starts (your account and Steam Guard, asked once; a sign-in token is kept in this device's keychain) and lends the game its Steam session and tickets. Copy your own Steam copy of the macOS game with profiles/brighter-shores/install.py. See profiles/brighter-shores/README.md.

getApp.name: Steam
steps: Install Steam on this Mac and sign in with the account that owns Brighter Shores.
Come back here: this page finds the game by itself. If Steam keeps it somewhere unusual, choose its folder.
